name: @idosgames/mcp
description: MCP server that serves the iDosGames Module & Skills Registry to AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…): list/pull composable game modules and the host scaffold, and load skills for @idosgames/core, the module contract, and composition; plus token launch and trade for game tokens from a local wallet key (EVM Uniswap V4 and Solana).
author: iDos Games
//: The registry is bundled into the package (registry/) so `npx @idosgames/mcp` works offline. Set IDOSGAMES_REGISTRY_URL to serve a hosted registry instead (once cloud.idosgames.com/registry is live).
